triage_rationale: Transforming a pure Python CLI ASCII-renderer (terminal/ANSI output, 21+ source files) into a cross-platform Tauri desktop/mobile application (Mac, Windows, Android) sealed in Docker requires: (1) Building an entirely new Rust+Tauri project architecture from scratch, (2) Creating a Python↔Rust bridge (pyo3 or subprocess), (3) Developing a web frontend layer for the Tauri shell, (4) Configuring Android cross-compilation with NDK, (5) Containerizing the full stack. Zero existing web/GUI/Rust/Tauri code exists in the repo. 21+ files created or modified across multiple new layers (Rust, TypeScript/HTML/CSS, Python adapter, Tauri config). 3+ new dependencies (Tauri, Rust web framework, Android NDK). Full architecture changes required.
framework: Python 3.14 CLI (existing core) → Tauri v2 (Rust core + Webview frontend) target overlay

architectural_patterns.state_management: N/A (Python CLI) → To be determined (Tauri web frontend, likely React/Svelte + Zustand/Context)
architectural_patterns.data_fetching: Subprocess/FFI bridge: Python CLI invoked from Rust backend via std::process::Command or pyo3
architectural_patterns.styling_engine: TBD (new web frontend layer, likely Tailwind CSS via shadcn/ui)
architectural_patterns.orm_database: None currently — not required for ASCII rendering
architectural_patterns.target_stack: Tauri v2 (Rust core + Webview frontend) + Python backend via FFI/subprocess bridge
architectural_patterns.rendering_pipeline: Python ANSI terminal output → webview Canvas/WebGL rendering layer
architectural_patterns.media_pipeline: FFmpeg external dependency must be bundled or managed for desktop/mobile

blast_radius.notes: All existing Python modules must remain functional. New Tauri/Rust/web layer wraps them. Terminal ANSI output must be redirected to webview canvas rendering. FFmpeg external dependency must be bundled or managed for desktop/mobile. Android cross-compilation requires NDK toolchain.

dependencies.tauri: NOT INSTALLED - must be added via `cargo add tauri` or `npm create tauri-app`
dependencies.web_frontend: TBD (likely vanilla TS + HTML/CSS or React via shadcn/ui)
dependencies.android_ndk: Required for Android target - NOT yet configured
dependencies.docker: Required for container sealing - must verify installed
conflicts: No existing Rust/Tauri/web project files conflict with the transformation, but Python subprocess spawning from Rust requires careful lifecycle management
FFmpeg external dependency complicates mobile bundling (Android NDK compatibility, dynamic linking)
Terminal ANSI output requires webview-based canvas rendering — cannot reuse terminal stdout directly
Windows ANSI support (_enable_windows_ansi in terminal.py) must be replaced with webview rendering
Python↔Rust bridge introduces serialization overhead (JSON/protobuf) for frame data
Docker multi-arch builds (arm64 for Android) add significant CI/CD complexity

complexity_warnings.warning: FFmpeg/FFplay subprocess pipeline — must be re-architected for Tauri Rust backend and mobile bundling. Largest single-file complexity.
ANSI terminal output must be redirected to webview canvas for desktop/mobile rendering. _enable_windows_ansi must be replaced.
5 procedural 3D renderers all depend on terminal_size() and ANSI drawing — must be refactored for canvas output with explicit dimensions.
Renderer registry assumes terminal-based rendering — interface must adapt for webview canvas with explicit pixel dimensions.
Android cross-compilation adds significant build complexity. NDK toolchain, Android-specific FFmpeg build, and Tauri mobile target configuration required.
Docker multi-arch image for Mac/Windows/Android requires cross-compilation toolchain, potentially large image sizes with bundled FFmpeg.
Bridge between Python rendering engine and Rust/Tauri shell is the architectural crux. pyo3 vs subprocess tradeoff must be resolved.
